title: 第560章 剑林开启第559章 棋差一招
content_zh:
“小师叔！你快点今天可是大事，别迟到了！”罗素云不停在拍打杨修的房门，杨修被吵的受不了穿衣服的速度都加快了几分：“来了！来了！别敲了！”
杨修将门打开，门外站的是一脸激动的罗素云还有一副疲倦模样的夏清幽。
“清幽怎么了？”杨修有些好奇的问道，罗素云摆摆手立刻开口说道：“不是我！不是我！”
夏清幽抬起头看了一眼杨修，随后伸手在脸上拍了拍说道：“昨天修炼太晚忘记时间了！”
杨修点点头将房门关好，他双手按在两人肩头便来到了剑斗场，让杨修意外的是他们三人居然是最后来到剑斗场的，看着这里精神萎靡的众人，杨修很是疑惑的开口问道：“不是有具体时间嘛！你们这是在这里等了一夜？”
陈老头是最先开口的：“杨小兄弟你不懂！一想到能进入剑林挑选自己心仪的剑，我内心的激动是压制不住的，你懂吧？”
杨修嘴角抽了抽不打算聊这个问题了，他环顾一圈也没发现吴天昊的身影，便开口问道：“这人都齐了，吴宗主怎么还没来？”
陈老头听到这里萎靡的精神瞬间消失，取而代之的是如同回光返照般的神采奕奕，他笑着摸了摸胡子说道：“看这时辰再有五个呼吸吴宗主便来了！”
陈老头话音刚落没多久，吴天昊便带着将近十个乾元剑宗的弟子和长老向这边走了过来。
杨修看到吴天昊之后，惊讶的再次看向陈老头，发现刚才精神抖擞的他再次恢复了萎靡，杨修笑着摇了摇头没再多说什么。
吴天昊跟邀请的各位大佬打好招呼之后，便来到杨修身侧站定，他犹豫了三秒开口问道：“杨兄弟找到组队的人选了没？”
杨修下意识摇了摇头，吴天昊一愣问道：“杨兄弟不知道剑林内有危险？”
杨修闻言来了兴致，他只是听说过剑会挑选主人还真没有听说过剑林内有什么危险：“喔？这倒是没听说过，吴宗主可以跟我讲讲到底怎么回事吗？”
吴天昊自然是愿意给杨修讲解的，他不顾别人焦急的目光，走到杨修身边开口说道：“有一些强大的剑有自己的思想，它们为了试探前来的人是否有挑选自己的资格，会在人反应不过来的时候释放自己的剑气，如果你实力不够大概率是会被这些剑的剑气所伤的！”
杨修闻言眼睛一亮，他摸着下巴问道：“竟然还有这样的事情，但是剑不都是死物嘛，为什么还会有属于自己的剑气呢？”
杨修说完话目光死死盯着吴天昊，他想要知道这剑林中的剑是否都是没有蕴养出剑灵的灵剑，因为小瑶跟他讲过灵剑之所以被称为灵剑，就是因为剑内有剑灵，而根据龙血剑的诞生来看，灵剑孕育出剑灵之前大多数都是有自己意识的。
吴天昊挠了挠后脑勺，他面色有些羞红，似乎有什么难以启齿的事情一般，杨修递给他一个将一切都讲出来的眼神，他便没再犹豫开口说道：“其实我也不太清楚，但之前进入剑林都会有这样的事情发生！”
得到答案的杨修点点头，随后思绪一转将之前搪塞陈老头的话再说了一遍：“夫子来的时候交代了我一些事情，所以我还是不组队了，好了！我看时间也不早了，我们还是快快进入秘境吧！”
“对啊！对啊！吴宗主我们都等不急了！”
“是啊！吴天昊你看看我！我这黑眼圈就是等了一夜的最好证明！”

“快快快！我的宝剑已经在呼唤我进去找他们了！”
杨修刚说完快点进去的话，便像火点燃了人们的焦急，他们立刻出声附和杨修，吴天昊听到众人的话，露出一个笑容说道：“抱歉！耽误了大家时间，现在请跟我一起来吧！”
吴天昊说完话看了一眼杨修，杨修会意便带着罗素云和夏清幽走到他的身边，吴天昊笑了笑没管其他人什么表情，便转头走进了剑斗场。
看着剑斗场内熟悉的环境，杨修不理解吴天昊为什么要带着他们来到这里，但当他跟着吴天昊走到场地最中央的时候，便明白吴天昊的为什么带他们来这里了，因为这剑斗场的最中央，便是剑林的入口。
只见吴天昊从怀中掏出一个令牌，他将令牌高举过头顶，头顶的阳光落在令牌上并没有被令牌挡住，而是穿过令牌落在剑斗场最中央的位置。
“轰隆隆～轰隆隆～”剑斗场内地面开始震动，一道道向下的石阶出现在众人面前，面前这惊世骇俗的一幕，让第一次进入剑林的弟子们目瞪口呆，他们似乎都在怀疑自己一夜没有休息，是不是出现了什么精神错乱，有些一些接受能力较差的人，已经开始上手掐自己了。
“嘶哈～”随着一阵阵疼痛的声音响起，众人也明白并不是熬夜熬出了幻觉
吴天昊环顾一圈得意的笑笑，当他目光最后看向杨修想从他脸上看出惊讶的时候，却发现杨修面色平静，仿佛早就知道会这样似的。
“夫子跟杨兄弟讲过剑林吗？”吴天昊没忍住直接开口问道。
杨修淡定摇头，随后缓缓说道：“我感受到里面有个秘境，那里应该就是剑林的入口吧！”
吴天昊点点头肯定了杨修的话，杨修得到答案双手按在罗素云和夏清幽肩头，一个瞬移来到剑林入口处，还没等两女反应过来便一头扎入剑林秘境内。
“诶？杨兄弟人呢？”吴天昊看着身侧的空地疑惑的开口，陈老头来到他的身边说道：“还问什么？当然是进去了，我说吴天昊你也太磨叽了，赶紧进去吧，别进去晚了，心仪的长剑被人抢了！”
吴天昊闻言一拍脑袋，杨修的实力他是知道一部分的，能瞬间进去并不让他惊讶，想到这里他便没再犹豫，一头扎进黑暗的通道里，在他屁股后面的人，也都人挤人往里进。

content_en:
"Uncle Junior! Hurry up, today is a big event, don't be late!" Russell Yun kept banging on Yang Xiu's door. Yang Xiu couldn't bear the noise and got dressed a little faster: "It's coming! It's coming! Stop knocking!"
Yang Xiu opened the door, and standing outside the door were an excited-looking Russell Yun and a tired-looking Karen Xia.
"What's wrong with Qingyou?" Yang Xiu asked curiously. Russell Yun waved his hand and said immediately: "It's not me! It's not me!"
Karen Xia raised her head and glanced at Yang Xiu, then reached out and patted her face and said, "I practiced so late yesterday that I forgot the time!"
Yang Xiu nodded and closed the door. He put his hands on the shoulders of the two of them and came to the sword fighting arena. To Yang Xiu's surprise, the three of them were the last ones to arrive at the sword fighting arena. Looking at the listless people here, Yang Xiu asked in confusion: "Isn't there a specific time? Have you been waiting here all night?"
Old Man Chen was the first to speak: "Brother Yang, you don't understand! When I think of being able to enter the sword forest and choose my favorite sword, I can't suppress the excitement in my heart. Do you understand?"
Yang Xiu's lips twitched and he didn't want to talk about this issue anymore. He looked around and didn't find Wu Tianhao, so he asked, "Everyone is here, why hasn't Sect Leader Wu come yet?"
When Old Man Chen heard this, his sluggish spirit disappeared in an instant, and was replaced by a spirit as bright as a flashback. He smiled and touched his beard and said: "Look at this moment, if there are five more breaths, Sect Leader Wu will be here!"
Not long after Old Man Chen finished speaking, Wu Tianhao came over with nearly ten disciples and elders of the Qianyuan Sword Sect.
After Yang Xiu saw Wu Tianhao, he looked at Old Man Chen again in surprise and found that he who had been so energetic just now had returned to sluggishness again. Yang Xiu smiled and shook his head without saying anything more.
After Wu Tianhao greeted all the invited bosses, he came to stand next to Yang Xiu. He hesitated for three seconds and asked, "Has Brother Yang found the candidate to form the team?"
Yang Xiu shook his head subconsciously, and Wu Tianhao was stunned and asked: "Brother Yang, don't you know there is danger in the sword forest?"
Yang Xiu became interested when he heard this. He had only heard that the Sword Club selects its master, but he had never heard of any dangers in the Sword Forest: "Oh? I've never heard of this. Can Master Wu tell me what's going on?"
Wu Tianhao was naturally willing to explain to Yang Xiu. He ignored the anxious looks of others, walked up to Yang Xiu and said, "There are some powerful swords that have their own thoughts. In order to test whether the person who comes is qualified to choose them, they will release their sword energy when the person cannot react. If you are not strong enough, there is a high probability that you will be injured by the sword energy of these swords!"
Yang Xiu's eyes lit up when he heard this, he touched his chin and asked: "There is such a thing, but aren't swords dead objects? Why do they still have their own sword energy?"
After Yang Xiu finished speaking, his eyes were fixed on Wu Tianhao. He wanted to know whether the swords in the sword forest were all spiritual swords that did not contain sword spirits, because Xiao Yao told him that the reason why spirit swords are called spirit swords is because there is a sword spirit in the sword. According to the birth of the Dragon Blood Sword, most of the spirit swords had their own consciousness before they gave birth to sword spirits.
Wu Tianhao scratched the back of his head, his face was a little red, as if there was something unspeakable, Yang Xiu gave him a look that told him everything, and he said without hesitation: "Actually, I don't know much about it, but this kind of thing has happened before when I entered the sword forest!"
After getting the answer, Yang Xiu nodded, then changed his mind and said again what he had said to prevaricate Old Man Chen: "Master told me some things when he came, so I better not form a team, okay! I think it's getting late, let's enter the secret realm quickly!"
"Yes! Yes! Master Wu, we can't wait any longer!"
"Yes! Wu Tianhao, look at me!The dark circles under my eyes are the best proof of waiting all night! "
“Quick, quick, quick! My sword is already calling me to come in and find them! "
As soon as Yang Xiu said his words to hurry in, it ignited people's anxiety like fire, and they immediately echoed Yang Xiu. Wu Tianhao heard everyone's words, showed a smile and said: "Sorry! I've wasted everyone's time, please come with me now! "
After Wu Tianhao finished speaking, he glanced at Yang Xiu. Yang Xiu understood and walked to him with Russell Yun and Karen Xia. Wu Tianhao smiled and turned around and walked into the sword fighting arena regardless of other people's expressions.
Looking at the familiar environment in the sword fighting arena, Yang Xiu didn't understand why Wu Tianhao brought them here. But when he followed Wu Tianhao to the center of the field, he understood why Wu Tianhao had brought them here, because the center of the sword fighting field was the entrance to the sword forest.
Wu Tianhao took out a token from his arms and raised it above his head. The sunlight falling on the token was not blocked by the token, but passed through the token and landed in the center of the sword fighting arena.
"Boom, boom, boom, boom~" The ground in the sword fighting arena began to shake, and stone steps descending appeared in front of everyone. This shocking scene in front of them stunned the disciples who entered the sword forest for the first time. They all seemed to wonder if they had gone insane after not resting all night. Some people with poor acceptance ability had already begun to pinch themselves.
"Hiha~" As the sounds of pain rang out, everyone understood that it was not a hallucination caused by staying up all night.
Wu Tianhao looked around and smiled proudly. When he finally looked at Yang Xiu to see the surprise on his face, he found that Yang Xiu's face was calm, as if he had known this would happen.
"Have Master told Brother Yang about Sword Forest? "Wu Tianhao couldn't help but asked directly.
Yang Xiu shook his head calmly, and then said slowly: "I feel that there is a secret realm inside, which should be the entrance to the Sword Forest! "
Wu Tianhao nodded and confirmed Yang Xiu's words. When Yang Xiu got the answer, he put his hands on the shoulders of Russell Yun and Karen Xia, teleported to the entrance of the Sword Forest, and plunged into the secret realm of the Sword Forest before the two women could react.
"Eh? Where are the Yang brothers? Wu Tianhao looked at the open space beside him and spoke doubtfully. Old Chen came to him and said, "What else do you ask?" Of course I went in. I said Wu Tianhao, you are too lazy. Go in quickly. Don’t go in too late. Your favorite long sword will be robbed! "
Wu Tianhao slapped his head when he heard this. He knew part of Yang Xiu's strength. He was not surprised that he could get in instantly. Thinking of this, he did not hesitate anymore and plunged into the dark passage. The people behind him also crowded in.
